notes.title: 2.6.10Updated！
notes.content:
2.6.10 new function description:
	In the "view element" or "view formula" function, click the element icon to view the relevant formula of the element.
	In addition, some elements can view the relevant formulas of the same element in other levels
	When obtaining a new formula, click the element icon of the product to view the relevant formula
	Click "view prompt" again to see the relevant formula not obtained
